facts.fact: A BCEAO decision published 25 June 2026 set 30 September 2026 as the deadline for WAEMU banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions to finish connecting to PI-SPI and open their services to the public.
facts.system: BCEAO decision of 25 June 2026 on the PI-SPI connection deadline

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, microfinance institutions, payment institutions
